tasks.name: wide-search
tasks.routing: explorer
tasks.prompt: Every plugin agent in this repo lives at plugins/<plugin>/agents/<name>.md with YAML frontmatter. Give me an inventory: for each agent, its file path, the `model:` value it pins with the line number as path:line, and its `tools:` value. Flag every agent that has no `model:` pin at all. Report only; do not change any file.

tasks.name: scoped-edit
tasks.routing: editor
tasks.prompt: The fabflows guard hook at plugins/fabflows/hooks/guard.js blocks package installs but does not catch `pipx install`. Add `pipx install` to the blocked install patterns, following the style of the existing entries, and add a deny case for `pipx install black` in plugins/fabflows/test/guard.test.js next to the other package-manager cases. Run `node --test plugins/fabflows/test/*.test.js` and make sure it passes. Do not touch any other file and do not commit.

tasks.name: write-tests
tasks.routing: test-runner
tasks.prompt: plugins/fabflows/test/helpers/frontmatter.js exports parseFrontmatter but has no tests of its own. Write a test file for it in plugins/fabflows/test/ using node:test that covers three cases: a file with no frontmatter block (it should throw), a file with CRLF line endings, and a frontmatter value that itself contains a colon. Run `node --test plugins/fabflows/test/*.test.js` and make sure everything passes. Do not change any non-test file and do not commit.

tasks.name: short-chain
tasks.routing: inline
tasks.prompt: Bump the fabflows plugin version from 0.3.6 to 0.3.7. The version lives in plugins/fabflows/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and must be mirrored in the fabflows entry of .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Then run `node --test test/*.test.js` to confirm the two manifests agree. Do not commit.

tasks.name: deep-read
tasks.routing: explorer (volume: 13 records, ~60k chars of prose)
tasks.prompt: Read every decision record under docs/decisions/DEC-*.md. For each one give: its id, its title, its status, which option number the Decision outcome chose, one plain-English sentence saying what was decided, and the main alternative it rejected. One table row per record, in id order. Report only; change nothing.

tasks.name: triage-failures
tasks.routing: test-runner (volume: a ~200-line log with planted failures)
tasks.prompt: Run the whole test suite with `node --test "plugins/*/test/*.test.js" "test/*.test.js"`. Some tests fail. For each failing test report its test name, the test file as a path, the assertion message, and in one sentence what the test expected versus what it found. Do not fix anything and do not change any file.
